stem.en: A double slit and a diffraction grating with thousands of slits, both with the same slit spacing, are illuminated with the same laser. How do their bright fringe patterns compare?
stem.et: Kaksikpilu ja tuhandete pilude arvuga difraktsioonivõre, mõlemal sama pilude vahekaugus, valgustatakse sama laseriga. Kuidas võrduvad nende heledate triipude mustrid?

label.en: The bright fringes appear at the same angles for both, but the grating's fringes are far sharper and narrower
label.et: Heledad triibud ilmuvad mõlemal samadel nurkadel, kuid võre triibud on palju teravamad ja kitsamad

label.en: The two patterns are identical in every respect, since the slit spacing is the same
label.et: Kaks mustrit on igas mõttes identsed, sest pilude vahekaugus on sama

label.en: The grating produces fringes at completely different angles from the double slit
label.et: Võre tekitab triibud kaksikpilust täiesti erinevatel nurkadel

label.en: More slits only makes the pattern brighter, with no change to its sharpness
label.et: Rohkem pilusid teeb mustri ainult heledamaks, muutmata selle teravust
